```markdown
# Security Policy

Thanks for helping keep `ledger-sync` and its users safe.

## Reporting a Vulnerability

**Please do not report security vulnerabilities through public GitHub issues, discussions, or pull requests.** Public reports expose users before a fix is available.

Instead, report vulnerabilities privately using one of the following:

1. **GitHub private vulnerability reporting (preferred).** Go to the repository's **Security** tab and click **Report a vulnerability** to open a private advisory. See [GitHub's guide](https://docs.github.com/code-security/security-advisories/guidance-on-reporting-and-writing-information-about-vulnerabilities/privately-reporting-a-security-vulnerability) for details.
2. **Email.** Send your report to the maintainers at `security@example.com`. _(Maintainers: replace this with a real, monitored address before publishing.)_

If you would like to encrypt your report, mention this in your first message and we will coordinate a secure channel.

## What to Include

To help us triage and fix the issue quickly, please include as much of the following as you can:

- A description of the vulnerability and its potential impact.
- Steps to reproduce, or a proof-of-concept.
- The affected version(s), commit, or configuration.
- Any suggested remediation, if you have one.

## Our Commitment

When you report a vulnerability privately, you can expect us to:

- Acknowledge receipt of your report within **3 business days**.
- Provide an initial assessment and expected timeline within **10 business days**.
- Keep you informed as we work on a fix.
- Credit you for the discovery once the issue is resolved, unless you prefer to remain anonymous.

## Coordinated Disclosure

We ask that you give us a reasonable opportunity to release a fix before any public disclosure. We aim to resolve confirmed vulnerabilities promptly and will publish a security advisory once a fix is available.

## Supported Versions

Security fixes are applied to the latest released version of `ledger-sync`. If you are running an older version, please upgrade to the latest release to receive security updates.
```
